hook: What do you say when a woman looks at you and says: 'I'm not fine'?
description:
What do you say when a woman looks at you and says: 'I'm not fine'?

What do you say when a woman looks at you and says: 'I'm not fine'? Personally, I say: 'Sorry to hear that, chief. May God see you through.' And I keep walking. Because the moment you say 'What's wrong?', you have officially opened an international financial case file. She will tell you: 'It's nothing serious.' Do not insist! It is a legal trap. If you press further, that is when you discover rent is due on Friday, her phone screen is damaged, and her third cousin in Ondo needs tuition fees. You thought you were conducting an emotional inquiry. She heard: 'Chief, how much do you want to transfer?' Problem has traveled from her tear ducts straight into your savings account. Curiosity is completely free in this country, but the answer will cost you two months salary.
